text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series is a world of pure
meritocracy.
Only the victors survive,
while the defeated have no choice but to
leave...

Yet, in such a world... what if?
What if you could run to your heart's content,
wherever it took you?

If you could run solely for the sake of your
own passion, that would be—

Today once again,
I watch over the horsegirls in training.
Unconsciously, my gaze grows stern.

Just the other day,
a horsegirl trained by a senior colleague
left the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She tried the maiden races again and again...
but in the end,
she couldn't break her maiden.
So she decided to move on and focus on higher
education...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...There were plenty of close races.
But she just couldn't reach that final
step.
I wanted to bridge that gap for her,
but...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing a trainee leave like this is
something I'll never get used to.
I mean,
no matter how many times I go through
it............ damn it...

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
I didn't leave any regrets behind.
I gave it my absolute all alongside her.
Even so, I can't help wondering...
Couldn't I have done more?

Unfortunately,
it's not an uncommon story...
About 70% of horsegirls who debut
leave the racing world without ever claiming
a single victory—

That's the kind of world the Twinkle Series is—
full of dreams, yet utterly cruel.
That's precisely why a Trainer must be
relentlessly obsessed with victory.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... You're a Trainer at the academy,
right?
choice_data_list: Huh? Yeah, that's me... Is somethi...
Huh? Yeah, that's me... Is somethi...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Um, I've been having some trouble with my
training...
If it's okay,
could you maybe watch me run?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaahhhhhh!!!
choice_data_list: Your form's falling apart! Stay fo...

text_block_list.text:
The sharpness of her final stretch was
remarkable; with proper guidance,
she could easily contest graded stakes.
That promise made me put even more passion
into my coaching—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much for your
feedback...
...I'm sorry for being so inadequate...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Right... I'm sorry...
At this rate,
running in the Twinkle Series is totally
out of the question...
choice_data_list: ...If you'd like, I want to train you!
...If you'd like, I want to train you!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Does that mean...
you're scouting me...?! 
I-I'm really happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry.
I don't think I have the confidence to keep
up with such intense coaching...

I watch the girl walk away.
...How many times has this happened now?
Being so strict that they end up turning
down my offer.
choice_data_list: Even so... winning has to be the t...

text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*――

Her running had a wonderful tempo.
At times powerful, at times light and airy,
her stride as she traversed the track was
delightfully rhythmic—

I must have been watching her run for quite
a while.
Glancing down at my watch, I realize—
choice_data_list: Huh?! Is it that late already?!

text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it,
my notebook was crammed with detailed
observations of her running style.
...Could she be the one?
choice_data_list: ...No. Let's call it a day for now.
...No. Let's call it a day for now.

text_block_list.text:
Remembering the failed scout from earlier...
I head back to my room.
I was no longer even sure how obsessed with
winning I was supposed to be.

...What a lamentabile melodia.
Could this be a cue for my musica,
I wonder?

The next day.
While working at my computer,
the sweet notes of a violin drifted in from
somewhere.

I follow the sound.
It's such a thrilling, uplifting melody...

～～～～～♪　Barchetta mia～♪
Santa Lucia～♪　Santa Lucia～♪

Now and then,
a cheerful singing voice joins in.
What a beautiful voice.
Who on earth could it be...?

Before I knew it,
I had left the Trainer's Office and stepped
into the courtyard.

Heheh. Awake at last, mio amore?
Why, I felt just like the Pied Piper of
Hamelin.

It seems you recognize me! Molto bene!
Such a lovely little agnellino. Come,
let me give you a hug!
choice_data_list: Whoa?! No, wait, hugs are a bit mu...

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Not to your liking?
There is no need to be shy!
Make yourself more comodo.
Adagio will do nicely.

Do that,
and it will be simply briiiillllante!
Now then, show me your own melodia!

Ah, forgive me.
It seems my passions carried me away.
Liszt's compositions are sublime,
yet one must still make the effort to be
understood.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—A pleasure to meet you, mio amore.
My name is Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I am the one who brings joyous musica to
your soul.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Sì! I saw you yesterday, you see.
From deep within you,
a doloroso melodia was overflowing.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
...A shadow falls over your heart,
does it not? I sensed a pianissimo.
Which is precisely why I simply must make
you energico once more.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—Morendo.
It seems your tension has yet to thaw...
Hmm. Very well!
Let me guide you to a place where you can
be giocoso. Come along!

And so, Sounds of Earth led me along
until we arrived at an outdoor performance
stage in the city.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The answer is crystal clear,
mio agnellino.
For there is only one thing worth performing
upon a stage!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, take this.
As for the tempo,
andante is perfectly fine.

With that, she held out toward me...
...a pair of bright red maracas—
